title: Pearl Harbor
photoNote: The forward magazine of USS Shaw (DD-373) explodes in floating drydock YFD-2 during the second attack wave, photographed from Ford Island with a dredging line in the foreground; the bow of USS Nevada (BB-36) with a tug alongside is at right. U.S. Naval History and Heritage Command photo NH 86118, public domain.
